newsitem.title: USA: Midland sees 97 shipping, ag revs over $75m.
newsitem.headline: Midland sees 97 shipping, ag revs over $75m.

text.p: Midland Inc said Thursday it expects 1997 revenues to exceed $75 million in part because of its reverse merger.
The company reported record restated audited financial results Thursday from its reverse merger February 18 of Mill-Agro (Hellas) SA, and Megehel Nautical SA, into America's Coffee Cup Inc.

Midland's 8-K, filed with the SEC on April 18, reported combined sales of the new company rose 13-fold from $2.0 million to $26.5 million and gross profits rose from a loss of $190,900 to a net of $4.0 million

The company said it anticipated the increase in gross sales will be aided by a newly-inaugurated regularly-scheduled cargo run of three of the company's container ships from Piraeus, Greece, into Taganrog, Russia.
Additionally, Midland's Agricultural Division will deliver 25,000 metric tons of sunflower seeds monthly for six months to Organise Sanayi Bolgesi of Manisa, Turkey, in a contract worth $43 million.

These results amply demonstrate the wisdom of this merger," Midland's North American Managing Director, Charles Stidham said, adding that he anticipates year-end 1997 revenues to exceed $75 million from the Company's shipping and agricultural divisions.
